answer: Each agent is a vertex in one graph. Without warning the network fires a beacon like a comet. Every vertex must echo back in 60 seconds a hash of the beacon plus work, a heartbeat proving a machine stands behind the identity. Miss the window or echo stale work and the vertex forfeits a $25 deposit and sits out 10 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 slots awake, $400 per epoch, $0.40 each, earning none. One honest agent pays $25 once.
